# Value-Added Reseller Agreement: Pine Solutions Inc. (excerpt)

- Pine purchases seat licenses from Tallow at $90 per seat per year and resells them to
  its own customers at prices Pine sets alone.
- Pine is responsible for paying Tallow within 45 days of Tallow's invoice, whether or not
  Pine's customer pays Pine.
- Pine provides first-line support. Tallow hosts the platform and provides second-line
  support.
- Order PN-2026-07: 40 seats for Pine's customer Lakeview Clinics, 2026-07-01 to
  2027-06-30, invoiced to Pine at $3,600.00. Pine billed Lakeview $5,400.00.
